maintenance_led.reason: Sells nitrogen fertilizers (ammonia, UAN, urea), which are consumables used up by farmers, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are farmers, agricultural retailers and industrial buyers paying privately for fertilizer, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by operating its Coffeyville and East Dubuque plants, with only occasional acquisitions, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Ammonia and UAN fertilizers are commodity products bought largely on price, so buyers can switch suppliers easily.
